# Preference: Meeting Style

## Statement

Alex prefers asynchronous communication and minimal meetings, using async tools like chat or documents instead.

## Context

Synchronous meetings interrupt flow state and should be reserved for complex discussions only.
Most work questions can be resolved with a written message or a shared document.
When meetings are necessary, they should have a clear agenda and end with recorded action items.
Alex uses calendar blocking to protect focused work time.
